description.value:
A sound out of a dead civilization's pride. Attempt an Intimidation check to Demoralize each enemy within 30 feet. You don't take the penalty for a target that doesn't understand you, and your result against each target is one degree of success better. On a critical success the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 3} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} for 1 round instead of Frightened 2.

Once per Communion.
